title: Apply for a firearms licence (business, club or government agency)
summary: This page provides information on how a business, club, or government agency can apply for a NSW firearms licence.
intro:
When applying for a NSW firearms licence, a business, club or government agency must nominate a licence holder or, if the business is a corporation, a 'nominated person'.

The nominated licence holder or person must complete the application on behalf of the business, club or government agency.

Evidence of a genuine reason for the possession and use of a firearm must be provided.

There can be more than one genuine reason on a firearms licence.

Firearms licences are issued for either a 2-year or 5-year term.

A fee is attached to this application. Fee exemptions are only applicable to businesses with the genuine reason of primary production.
who_can_apply: Be at least 18 years of age.
Be a fit and proper person to have access to firearms.
Have successfully completed a firearms safety training course applicable to the type of firearm licence being applied for.
Be able to justify the genuine reason for possessing or using a firearm.
The nominated licence holder/person must be a resident of NSW.
what_you_need: Proof of identity documents (such as a driver licence and Medicare card).
A copy of the firearms safety awareness certificate or pistol safe handling certificate.
Details of the address(es) where the firearms will be safely stored.
Documentation to support each genuine reason/category.
A current credit card for payment (if applicable).
If applying for a licence over and above a category A firearms licence, evidence that a ‘special need’ exists for a category B, C, D, or H licence.

how_to_steps.text: You will be taken to the NSW Police Force Community Self Service Portal.
Check that you have all the documentation required.
Follow the prompts to complete your application.

more_info.text: If you have any questions relating to firearms licences, please call the Firearms Registry customer service line on 1300 362 562 between 9am and 4pm Monday to Friday (excluding public holidays).

faqs.q: What is required when a business, club, or agency applies for a firearms licence?
faqs.a: The nominated licence holder or person must complete the application on behalf of the business, club, or government agency, and evidence of a genuine reason for possession and use of a firearm must be provided.

faqs.q: What are the possible terms for a firearms licence?
faqs.a: Firearms licences are issued for either a 2-year or 5-year term.

faqs.q: Are there fee exemptions for businesses?
faqs.a: Fee exemptions are only applicable to businesses with the genuine reason of primary production.
